findings.title: Widened verbs refuse ordinary per-task prompts that only mention a phase or a skill name (Ivan, workers, questions)
Deny message tells the session to dispatch Ivan while refusing an Ivan call, and never names the phrase that matched
Common phrasings still slip past the guard: other verbs, other gap words, hyphen or markdown-wrapped jargon, curly double quotes, a bare slash command
SKILL.md-read rule misses any absolute or plugin-rooted path
An unrelated negation before a colon or dash suppresses a real delegation
Release gate never runs the 50 narrowing pins added by 00267
QA and review sessions that quote the guard's trigger phrases cannot dispatch their lanes (this run lost one dispatch)
Compound-noun exception and colon-lead with a widened verb used as cover
Unicode lookalikes evade the guard: other hyphens, invisibles outside the five-point strip list, homoglyphs, combining marks
Live 0.9.0 hooks crash with exit 1 on invalid UTF-8 or deep nesting, letting gated calls through; fix is on master, unreleased
A Write to a repo-root backlog/ path with a lone surrogate in the name passes the PRD-location gate
Guard crosses its 5s hook timeout at ~7.8 MB crafted or ~37 MB plain prompt; 00267 made it 2.5x-10x slower per MB
CHANGELOG says read_input fails open on non-UTF-8 input, but invalid bytes are replaced and still checked
Guard test docstring and test name state stale fixture counts (four observed, 20 allowed)
